LBR.note: Opinion calls for dispute rules; none stated as drafted or in force.

facts.fact: The op-ed says a Central Bank of Liberia directive provides for government-to-person mobile-money payments to go through the national electronic payment switch from 27 October 2025; no payments made are reported.
The op-ed says Pay Na-Na, the national platform introduced in December 2025, is in growing use, according to the Central Bank of Liberia's Executive Governor.
The op-ed says the Central Bank's directive has mobile-money collections for government following from 1 December 2025; no collections in service are reported.
